title: Feed @mentions ride the notification router and the Mentions switch works

source.ref: Meta scan 2026-10-26 (audits/meta-scan-2026-10-26.md), Phase 4 follow-up: remaining direct bell inserts

detail: fanOutMentions wrote one batched bell insert that ignored the Mentions setting. It now routes the registry row post.mention (mentions, in-app) once per mentioned member, so each member's own inapp_mentions switch, suppression and the outbox retry apply. The Mentions in-app switch in settings is now real: WIRED_PREFERENCE_CHANNELS lists mentions as in-app, and the pinned hidden-set test in lib/notifications/wired.test.ts moved from nine hidden to eight with the owner's go-ahead (Daniel, 'update the wired-switch pin', 2026-10-26). Mention email and push stay unwired: no emitter exists.

verify.note: Exits 0 once feed @mentions go through the notification router.
